IMG0222, IMG0225, IMG0226 and IMG0229 were rerendered after the first pass: IMG0222 had read as a bleached bone joint, IMG0225 showed a round cave mouth onto a full landscape, IMG0226 used rectangular longhouse forms, and IMG0229 showed a modern-looking field grid with tracks.
